scope: 32 close-view brick crops (index status ok after the eye check, 14 excluded). primary = verified labels only; sensitivity also keeps the unverified DEFECT (any_1740 ep_0017). LOEO over episodes (Studio: participant groups).

method.ci: 95% percentile, class-stratified bootstrap over crops (crops of one episode are correlated, so intervals are optimistic)
method.anomaly_threshold: fold threshold = max score of the fold's training GOOD crops
method.fusion_fit: LR on the training folds only, standardised, class-balanced, L2 1e-2, 3000 steps

adoption_rule: candidate adopted only if, on every colour (each with DEFECT and GOOD crops), F1 >= best single (tape verdict, anomaly model) on the same crops and, for LR, AUROC >= best single score; overall F1 (and AUROC for LR) strictly above; at least 5 DEFECT episodes
